title: When was Lisbon's red wind warning issued: 07:18 or 08:31?
summary: The lead-time table first used 08:31 (a press time) for the red wind warning. IPMA's own CAP message carries the time it was sent: 07:18:40 on Tuesday.
closes: Closed by the primary source: IPMA's CAP message.

sides.held_by: the press (Lusa), the first time we had

answer.text: IPMA sent the red wind warning for Lisbon at 07:18:40 UTC on 10 November (its CAP message); 08:31 was a press time.
answer.label: fact
